claim_scope.statement: Evidence residue migration inventory was preserved in local evidence and represented by repo-publishable closeout receipts without publishing raw evidence.

source_summary.summary: The local archive manifest records 67 copied raw-like evidence files and this receipt provides the publishable claim proof for the migration closeout packet.

redactions.summary: Raw-like evidence remains in local-private evidence; this receipt publishes only bounded refs, digests, and summaries.

limitations.description: The copied raw-like evidence files are intentionally not repo-publishable.
limitations.impact: Auditors must use the local archive reference and digest when raw-file inspection is required.

local_evidence_refs.description: Local-private archive manifest for the evidence residue migration closeout.

outcome.summary: Evidence residue migration closeout has publishable claim proof while preserving raw evidence locally.

rollback_or_discard.trigger: Use if the local archive manifest or raw path list no longer supports the bounded claim.
rollback_or_discard.instructions: Keep the local archive and regenerate this publishable receipt from fresh inventory evidence.
